journey.name: PRISMA UY — Verificación en Vivo de Descuentos Bancarios y Billetera
journey.description: Valida en Android (Pixel 8 / Android 14) la interfaz móvil PRISMA UY, el abanico 3D de tarjetas uruguayas, la verificación bancaria en vivo SHA-256 (HTTP 200) al abrir un comercio y los escalafones completos de tarjetas (Débito, Clásica, Gold, Platinum, Black, Personal Bank / Select).

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen showing "¿Con Cuál Pago? UY", the 7-day selector, the 3D ISO-7810 card fan ("Mis Tarjetas"), and the live calculator ("¿Cuánto vas a gastar?")
Tap the first merchant perforated pass ("Tienda Inglesa")
Verify that the Terminal de Caja POS modal opens and displays the green badge "✓ VERIFICADO EN VIVO · HTTP 200 · SHA-256"
Tap the close button on the Terminal de Caja modal
Tap the "Tarjetas" button in the top bar
Verify that the wallet configuration sheet displays the full Uruguayan bank card tiers (Débito, Crédito Volar, Gold, Platinum, Black / Infinite, Personal Bank / Select)
Tap the theme toggle button ("◐") and verify that Modo Cuarzo (Light Mode) renders with high contrast readability
